faqs.q: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.a: Choose a doctor and branch, then select an available slot from the booking page.
Yes. Doctors with telemedicine enabled can be booked for an online visit.
You can pay online or at the branch. Fees are shown in BDT before booking.

faqs.q: How do I request an ambulance?
faqs.a: Call the emergency hotline immediately or use the ambulance request link above.
